artboards.title: The Kit — pick a font here

annotations.text:
START HERE.

The Kit board has a font picker — four rounded faces on the same sample. Click through them and tell me which one, and I will set the other three boards to match.

Everything is drawn in Fredoka for now.

The table, cloth, rails, pockets and balls are the game's own values — lifted straight out of tableThemes.ts and ballStyle.ts. Nothing about them is redesigned.

What changed is the room around them: oiled wood, brass and leather under the lamp, instead of flat neon.

Click any mode in the rack — the table re-racks and changes cloth.

The HUD sits at the edges and the controls are one deck along the bottom, so the table is never competing with a panel.

Spin is an actual cue ball. The aim guide is the dashed line the game already draws.
Every cue is previewed on the cloth it will be seen against, and your kit stays on the left — so equipping something is a change you watch happen rather than go looking for.
